laws.statement: validation generations increase and reject stale completion
submission results identify the active submission generation
unknown events reject atomically instead of resetting form state
malformed construction input returns typed failures
construction ceilings bound iterative path and output work
library-owned branches freeze without mutating caller leaves
reinitialize establishes a clean dirty baseline while preserving requested metadata groups
issue replacement changes only the selected source
multi-field issues project one canonical issue into every related field
canonical field paths round-trip through their encoded representation
invalid submission focuses the first invalid field before announcing the ordered summary
